title: Add an MIT LICENSE file at the repository root
body:
## Summary

The repo currently has no top-level license file. The README's License section explicitly says "Not yet specified. An explicit license will be added before mainnet." Time to add it.

MIT is the right call: short, permissive, well-understood by reviewers and contributors, and consistent with the rest of the GenLayer ecosystem.

## Acceptance criteria

A submitted PR must:

1. Add a new file named `LICENSE` at the repository root (no extension, all caps).
2. The file must be the standard MIT License text.
3. The copyright line must reference the year `2026` and the holder `tommycet`.
4. The PR must come from the same repository (tommycet/proofworks-genlayer).

## Reward

Funded as a ProofWorks bounty case. Worker payout on APPROVE.
